scope: R2 contract-only closure over the sealed M461 R1 prereview and its 95/100 independent hammer. M40 was not opened, M453b was not read or executed, no RTL was run, and docs/359 was not modified.

r2_supersedes_r1_only_for: primary compact-path 48-bit assignment descriptor layout and lifecycle
center-to-slot remap validity, lookup and unknown behavior
B shared-logical versus per-tile-address config accounting

primary_48bit_descriptor_contract.logical_bank_geometry: 3000 words x 48 bits per phase bank; two role-pingpong banks

bit_layout_lsb0.bits_34_28: global_center_id7; frozen M453a flat center ID 0..127
bit_layout_lsb0.bit_41: descriptor_valid1; must be one for every stored descriptor

legal_descriptor_predicate: descriptor_valid is one and reserved6 is zero
destination_row_id is 0..2999 and strictly increases over compact replay addresses
center ID selects the exact frozen q128 mask for this phase
stored distance equals the recomputed Hamming distance
stored use_pwp equals the strict 1+distance<popcount(original) predicate
primary_48bit_descriptor_contract.fallback_semantics: use_pwp=0 remains exact bit-sparse. It must not read remap or PWP storage. Its correction source mask is original16 and no minus mask is emitted. Center and distance remain stored only for exact matcher/replay checking.
primary_48bit_descriptor_contract.pwp_semantics: use_pwp=1 requires a valid compact remap and exact signed residual masks plus=original&~center and minus=center&~original. PWP plus every signed correction update reconstructs the original mask exactly.

valid_and_sentinel.stored_valid_word: bit41=1; an all-zero 48-bit word can never be a legal descriptor
valid_and_sentinel.synthetic_end_sentinel: exactly 48'h000000000000, generated by control when replay_request_pointer equals sealed_active_count; it is not fetched from descriptor SRAM and is never sent to the arithmetic backend
valid_and_sentinel.full_3000_active_rows: addresses 0..2999 hold valid descriptors; pointer value 3000 synthesizes end without a 3001st word
valid_and_sentinel.empty_phase: sealed_active_count=0; address zero immediately synthesizes end and no descriptor/PWP SRAM request occurs
valid_and_sentinel.stale_inactive_memory: need not be physically cleared; bank_epoch_valid=0 and assignment_sealed=0 make every stale word unreachable

center_to_compact_slot_contract.used_center_validity: one sealed 128-bit used_pwp_center_bitmap per phase; bit c is one iff at least one stored descriptor has use_pwp=1 and global_center_id=c
center_to_compact_slot_contract.slot_encoding: seven-bit slot_id 0..Nused-1 in a 128-entry logical remap table; unmapped table payload is don't-care but unreachable
center_to_compact_slot_contract.deterministic_assignment: slot_id is the zero-based rank of global_center_id among ascending set bits of sealed used_pwp_center_bitmap
center_to_compact_slot_contract.inverse_check: slot_to_center[slot_id] must equal global_center_id; mapped slots are injective, contiguous and cover exactly popcount(used_pwp_center_bitmap)
center_to_compact_slot_contract.pwp_block_validity: every mapped slot has eight per-output-block valid bits. Bank-ready requires all eight bits for every mapped slot, no extra mapped slot, and no pending materializer write.
center_to_compact_slot_contract.lookup_timing: For a replayed use_pwp descriptor, descriptor response is held until the synchronous remap response and selected PWP-block validity are checked. The frozen event model must charge the chosen fixed remap latency or prove an II=1 pipelined lookup; it may not call the lookup zero-cycle.
center_to_compact_slot_contract.fallback_lookup: use_pwp=0 bypasses remap and PWP address generation completely
center_to_compact_slot_contract.invalid_lookup_behavior: use_pwp=1 with bitmap bit zero, slot_id>=Nused, inverse mismatch, missing PWP-block valid, wrong epoch/bank/tag, or duplicate slot mapping suppresses all accepts/requests/outputs in that cycle and raises sticky protocol_error
center_to_compact_slot_contract.unknown_behavior: In Synopsys VCS/SVA, any X/Z in descriptor valid/control, used bitmap bit, slot ID, inverse ID, PWP-block valid, bank/epoch/tag/address or lookup response is illegal, fail-closed and sticky until reset. Unknown payload cannot be converted to a miss, fallback or slot zero.

assignment_bank_lifecycle.roles: two physical assignment banks have disjoint CURRENT_REPLAY and NEXT_CAPTURE roles; same-bank read/write is forbidden
invalidate_next: before accepting a new phase, set next bank_epoch_valid=0, assignment_sealed=0, sealed_active_count=0, used bitmap=0, remap-ready=0 and PWP-ready=0
do not rely on clearing SRAM payload
capture: accept exactly 3000 source rows in destination_row_id order 0..2999
zero original rows produce no descriptor
each nonzero row is matched and exact-checked before one 48-bit descriptor write at compact address active_count
increment active_count only on acknowledged descriptor write
no descriptor/remap/PWP read is legal from the next bank during capture
seal: after source row 2999, wait for matcher child-stage drain and every descriptor write acknowledgement
atomically latch sealed_active_count, used_pwp_center_bitmap, phase tag and epoch, then assert assignment_sealed
sealing with a pending write, malformed descriptor or count above 3000 is illegal
materialize_and_remap: construct deterministic center-to-slot mappings only from the sealed used bitmap
materialize every mapped center/output-block exactly and set its PWP-block valid only after the conservative separate write completes
assert remap_ready and pwp_ready only after inverse/contiguity/completeness checks and generator idle
role_switch: next phase may become CURRENT_REPLAY only when assignment_sealed, remap_ready, pwp_ready, next weight/config valid, generator idle, no next write is outstanding, and the old current replay plus downstream update_delta drain is complete
switch tag, epoch, assignment, remap, PWP, weight and config roles atomically
early or partial role switch is fail-closed
read_and_replay: issue descriptor SRAM addresses 0..sealed_active_count-1 strictly in compact order
check returned bank, epoch, tag and address; require the full legal descriptor predicate and strictly increasing destination_row_id
hold the descriptor through remap/PWP validation and all update_delta chunks for that destination before advancing according to the frozen backend protocol
when request pointer equals sealed_active_count, synthesize the all-zero end sentinel without an SRAM read
phase completion requires no outstanding descriptor/remap/PWP/weight read, no descriptor FIFO entry, no adapter output and acknowledged downstream completion
assignment_bank_lifecycle.reload_and_recovery: Configuration reload is legal only when both roles are quiescent, no valid/output/request is pending and no role switch occurs. protocol_error is sticky and reset-only; reload never clears it.

fail_closed_illegal_states: capture write to CURRENT_REPLAY or replay read from NEXT_CAPTURE/unsealed bank
same-bank descriptor read and write, address outside 0..2999, read address >= sealed_active_count, or active_count >3000
invalid descriptor, nonzero reserved bits, zero original, non-increasing/duplicate destination_row_id, distance mismatch or use_pwp mismatch
stored or synthesized sentinel accepted by remap, PWP or arithmetic backend
fallback descriptor causing any remap/PWP read or minus-mask emission
PWP descriptor using an invalid, out-of-range, non-injective, incomplete or unknown remap/PWP slot
seal with pending matcher/write work, role switch before all validity/drain fences, or stale epoch/tag response
config reload during capture, seal, materialize, replay, drain or buffered output
any simulation X/Z on a validity, payload, address, tag, epoch, bank-role, ready/valid or response field
atomic_fail_closed_effect: Every illegal same-cycle event suppresses descriptor/remap/PWP/weight request accept, response accept, role switch and update_delta valid/accept in that cycle; it sets sticky protocol_error and holds all externally visible outputs quiescent until reset.

descriptor_storage_sensitivity.upper_16_physical_bits: padding only, forced zero on every write and checked zero on every read for this sensitivity point; they do not add semantics or capacity
descriptor_storage_sensitivity.claim_boundary: 36,000 B is logical payload only. Until a target SRAM macro/banking result exists, resource tables must show both 36,000 B logical and 48,000 B 64-bit-row sensitivity; neither is physical macro area. Cross-row packing is a separate unadmitted DSE.

percentile_closure.metric: all-128 centers times eight output blocks, weight-update-only structural reference

standard_nearest_rank.definition: sort ascending; one-based rank=ceil(0.95*n), zero-based index=ceil(0.95*n)-1

legacy_floor_n_minus_1.allowed_wording: legacy floor-index statistic only; never label it standard nearest-rank p95

logical_shared_config.interpretation: one logically shared q128 config bank per phase role, addressable by both output tiles

per_tile_compatibility_address_footprint.equation_per_tile: 288 config address view + 6144 weights + 20480 q32 parent PWP + 640 child scratch
per_tile_compatibility_address_footprint.interpretation: compatibility address-map footprint only; the 288-byte config range appears in each tile view but is not automatically a second physical config instance

B_config_footprint_closure.claim_boundary: Future resource tables must name which physical option is used. They may not add two per-tile address footprints and then also claim a shared 576-byte physical implementation, or use the shared lower bound while describing replicated config ports.

next_gate: Independent delta hammer must verify R1 and its review seals, recompute all descriptor/storage/percentile/config arithmetic, attack every illegal-state clause and confirm docs/359 unchanged before this R2 may inform a future M461 exact-SHA contract.
red_lines: Do not open M40, read or run M453b, or write RTL from this closure.
Do not call the 48-bit descriptor bank a 36,000-byte physical macro.
Do not map an invalid/unknown remap response to slot zero or fallback.
Do not issue a stored or synthetic sentinel to the arithmetic backend.
Do not call 1576 standard nearest-rank p95; canonical standard p95 is 1584.
Do not mix B per-tile compatibility address footprint with shared physical config storage.
